text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the tryouts, I'm walking
around town when I find...

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hey you! Any interest in watching some
freestyle races? We've got
some real fire
bouts lined up over in the alley today!

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Staff A
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is cool and all, but
freestyle races are just as exciting!
Oh, you
there! Miss Umamusume! You should check
this out too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Freestyle, huh?
Whoa, hey! Look who it is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mhmm, yeah. Just warming up for some
training, and thinking about
what you said
the other day about a style that suits me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But yeah,
this freestyle thing? I've always
known about it, but I've
never actually
watched a race in-person...

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Staff A
text_block_list.text:
You both seem pretty interested! Knew it!
Just come on over here,
then! Feel free to
join a race at any time if you want, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Freestyle racing is popular among amateur
Umamusume who want to run unbound by
rules and norms. They're often held in
empty lots
rented for the very purpose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some runners prefer these kinds of races
over going pro, no matter how fast they
may be. They compete as their hearts
desire in front of
a great many fans.

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaa!
Uooogh!
I'm number one around
here! Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With so many rowdy, rough-and-tumble
running styles at play,
freestyle is plenty
different to watching Twinkle Series
races. The
competitive spirit on display is quite
moving in its own way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This feels totally different from all
those
official races... So this is
freestyle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Like, just watching 'em gets
me so pumped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah... Yeah, think I do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there,
mind if I join in? Or I can wait
for the next one, doesn't
matter to me!

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, newbie lookin' to jump in? Love the
enthusiasm. Sure, come on
over. What's
your name?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh, Palmer! It's uh, Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Tongue-pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a Mejiro eh? Looks like we got a celeb
on our hands. Name's kinda long though,
so how about we just call you Palmer? Oh
yeah, we'll draw straws  to determine gate
numbers before the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh, okay? So just "Palmer" is fine?

text_block_list.name: Tongue-pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? No way people'll remember a name
that long. Might not even
remember the
short version if ya don't win...

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Don't think too hard about it. Just gotta
win, yeah? It's all about strength and
runnin' your own way in the freestyle
world. Let's go,
Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yeah, lookin' forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And they're off! In the lead, we have a
first-time entrant, number two
in the red
tracksuit! Can she keep it up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Okay, calm down, and let's do this like
always...)

text_block_list.name: Determined Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hraaagh! Y'all better stop screwin' around
if you wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Oh yikes, now that's some fierce running! Kinda incredible to see it up close!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I should try out... something like
that? I mean... no better
chance than a
race like this!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(And right now I'm just newbie number two
in the red tracksuit. I'm not
a Mejiro—I'm
Palmer!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Win or lose, I'm not a Mejiro!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Tch! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Fast, she's fast! Number two Palmer takes
first! That speed was
actually crazy! She
wins by six whole lengths!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Dang, how did I... This is way too much fun!

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa whoa, where the hell did that
come from? That got me all
fired up! Let's
go again, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, sure thing! Wanted to run some
more anyways! Kinda wanna
tear up the
track until there's nothin' left!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(My legs just won't stop! And this breeze
feels great! It feels like I'm
moving my
body in a way that I can give my all!)

text_block_list.name: Tongue-pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at her go! She's kinda like,
stupidly fast. Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Heh, crap! Might've gotten a little too wild...

text_block_list.name: Tongue-pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pfft, hahaha! Now she's flounderin'! Don't tell me you didn't think this through? Haha, now that's too funny!

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Palmer! Go! Run like hell!
You're somethin'
else, Palmer! Smash that finish!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you got it! This time, I'll run like
never before! Watch me snatch
the win
and burn this run into your memories!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time all of the freestyle races
scheduled for the day are over,
the frenzy
surrounding Mejiro Palmer has reached its
peak.

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer!
Paaal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, everyone's so fired up... Hehe, and
seriously, for me? I don't
think I've ever
heard my name called out so much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm SO hyped up right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My head's still spinning from all
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? That's the first time that's ever
happened to me. Nothing like that tryout
race, for sure. People who didn't even
know that I'm a Mejiro were cheering my
name!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
High-key, that felt so, so awesome! I
wanna keep doing that from
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! I want everyone to know my
name! To spread the word
of "Mejiro
Palmer" far and wide!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are positively dazzling.
I can see
that she's finally found her
dream and her
calling. And without a second thought...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, so are you like, scouting me?
For real?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm beyond stoked. So yeah, let's do this thing, Trainer!
